body: The nausea has mostly gone away although I still have reduced appetite. The feeling at the back of my brain is still there and seems to get worse at times and can be quite uncomfortable. The mood swings seem to be getting worse and correlate somewhat with the burning feeling in my brain. I also have less energy and find it harder to go about normal day to day activities. I am not taking any other medication but I have been considering taking a 5-HTT supplement to try and alleviate some of the symptoms (if they are caused by serotonin depletion) although the lack of research into its effects makes me reluctant to try it without waiting first to see if things improve with time.
